successors.name: Livonian Brothers of the Sword
successors.text: the Livonian lands: the Daugava Livonians, Satezele, Turaida, Idumeja and Metsepole

ledger.x: 1201: Riga is founded on the Daugava Livs' land.
1208: the last Livonian lands are Christian.
1208: the fighting with the bishopric and the Order ends; Terra Mariana had been made an ecclesiastical state on 2 February 1207.

1208: the Livonian lands are under the Bishop of Riga and the Brothers of the Sword; 'Livonians were eventually completely assimilated by the Latvians' in Livonia, while the Livonian Coast community survived.

wars.name: Livonian Crusade
wars.outcome: The Livs lost the Daugava mouth (Riga, 1201), Turaida (1206) and by 1208 all their lands; Terra Mariana was established as an ecclesiastical state on 2 February 1207.

certainty.note: Tribal lands named by the page without any coordinates or boundary; the circles are approximate.
